A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DepthVanish study. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–E are readable and support a complete comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original digital attacks on KITTI and DrivingStereo, physical stereo-camera experiments, ablations, and appendix robustness and transferability results.

after.justification: v2 retains these original digital and physical experimental results, including the ablations and appendix analyses.

M1.justification: The grid-based attack and joint texture/interval optimization remain unchanged. Sections 5.1–5.3 retain the same patch construction, gradient updates, regional MSE, entropy and total-variation losses, and loss weights.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate KITTI-scene, the same four DrivingStereo weather subsets, manually captured physical stereo scenes, and Intel RealSense D435i. Rotation, distance, patch-size, and model-transfer scenarios are retained.

E2.justification: Table 1 and Figure 4 retain the Stereoscopic and Stereopagnosia patch adaptations and the authors' grid-based comparator. Newly cited stereo methods are not added to the evaluated comparisons.

E3.justification: Section 6.4 corrects the reported source/target roles: v1 describes a KITTI-optimized patch attacking five models, whereas v2 describes patches optimized against five models and evaluated on D435i. This aligns the description with the retained Figure 7, without establishing new runs. Sample counts, metrics, and other stated settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The interval-spacing and rotation analyses, entropy/total-variation ablations, and Appendix C studies of patch size, depth, transferability, and distance are retained with the same evidence.

E5.justification: Both versions report mean and standard deviation for D1/EPE and variance shading for the interval-spacing analysis. v2 adds no repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All 40 mean-and-standard-deviation entries in Table 1 match, and the corresponding main-text and appendix result plots and depth maps are retained. For example, DepthVanish's RAFT-Stereo D1 remains 89.31±6.56 and EPE remains 66.01±6.18. No new empirical outcomes are reported.

T1.justification: Section 4 corrects the physical distance corresponding to disparity c from c to (f×B)/c. Equations (3)–(4) explicitly restrict predictions to the patch region through F^p, aligning the formal statement with the existing patch-local intent. No new theorem or proof is introduced.

C1.justification: The central contributions remain interval-structured adversarial patches, joint texture/structure optimization, and effectiveness in digital and physical stereo systems, including RealSense. Changes from 'striped' to 'grid' and from 'state-of-the-art' to 'advanced' do not introduce a different contribution or evaluated scope.

C2.justification: Section 6.4 corrects Figure 7's interpretation from transfer across five target models to transfer from different optimization models to D435i. The mechanism explanations, physical-performance caveats, and Appendix D limitations otherwise retain their substance.

D1.justification: v2 adds an official DepthVanish code-release link in the abstract and specifies that Figure 8 uses a patch optimized with PSMNet on KITTI. These improve access information and experiment documentation; the appendix hardware, checkpoints, calibration procedure, and capture details remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds references to CREStereo, Iterative Geometry Encoding Volume, Patch Is Enough, and DoubleStar. Section 2 adds a short account of recurrent stereo refinement, while the paper's overall positioning and existing cited works are retained.

P1.justification: The revision makes sentence-level grammar and terminology edits throughout, expands several explanations, and revises the conclusion. Author affiliations and contribution notes change, the header identifies NeurIPS 2025, and funding acknowledgments are added. The scientific section organization and narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: Several figures are enlarged and repositioned, notably replacing the wrapped layouts of Figures 2 and 6 with full-width displays. Rotation/distance labels are repositioned and face masking is revised. The same table, figures, and result panels are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 improves precision by correcting the disparity-to-depth statement and the explanation of the D435i evaluation. Larger figures, clearer wording, and the added code-access pointer improve readability and reproducibility information. These are useful, limited gains; the underlying method, empirical evidence, and acknowledged limitations remain substantially unchanged.
